desc: 从白底主图到腋下涂抹、香型轮换与配方透明对照的身体护理套图
name: 清爽随身固体香体止汗膏款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：整支直立膏体干净呈现，承担主图合规白底位。
一秒交代核心利益，右侧立产品、左侧整片留白承接标题。
用原料道具把气味翻译成可看的生活方式，建立代入与偏好。
示范真实使用动作与顺滑肤感，右侧空栏承接要点清单。
把产品放进健身与通勤日常，强化随身补香的使用动机。
微距证明膏体饱满顺滑、贴合推口结构，替代空口功效话术。
顶视阵列铺陈质地并留出一整列空白排除项位，讲清配方立场。
用左右双栏与勾叉位承接配方立场对照，两侧主张全部留空不自证。
把可选气味与形态摆上同一架，完成挑选并提高连带。
以透明配方对照与背标版式收口降风险，表格单元一律留空。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for packshots, warm blush-to-caramel gradient #E7C6B5 into #8A5B41 for benefit and texture screens, pale sand-grey #EDE9E4 studio sweep for body screens, one clear glass shelf line reused as the stage
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line tick glyphs and small circular outline badges in #8A5B41 only, always delivered as empty slots
style.lightingSystem: soft diffused studio light from the upper left with a broad white fill card, low-contrast wrap shadows, one soft contact shadow grounding every object, satin highlights on skin and case, no hard speculars, daylight-balanced on body screens
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm minimal body-care visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, pale sand-grey #EDE9E4, caramel brown #8A5B41 and blush apricot #E7C6B5, with product-matched accent colours allowed only on the variant line-up screen; warm tone throughout; backgrounds are seamless white, a blush-to-caramel gradient or a pale sand-grey studio sweep with one clear glass shelf line; soft diffused upper-left key light with broad fill, low-contrast wrap shadows and a single soft contact shadow, never hard speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with generous letter spacing; thin single-weight line tick glyphs and circular outline badge slots in caramel brown #8A5B41, always left empty; stable upright slight 3/4 product angle and scale, body screens cropped from the jawline down with no identifiable face; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no identifiable faces or model likeness
style.presentationRules: upright product with a stable slight 3/4 or straight-on angle across packshot, benefit and line-up screens; body screens always cropped from the jawline down with no identifiable face; variant accents may differ per unit only on the line-up screen; the label is never redesigned
style.surfaceSystem: pale matte stone counter #EDE9E4, clear glass shelf edge, warm off-white paper field #FAF7F2 for information screens
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with generous letter spacing, single weight family; every source headline is stripped and replaced by empty reserved copy zones
